questions.question: A cuboidal block of metal is melted and recast into 12 identical cubes. If the original block had dimensions 24 cm × 6 cm × 6 cm, what is the edge of each cube?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total volume of **cuboidal block** = 24 × 6 × 6 = 864 cm³.

Volume of each of the **12 identical cubes** = 864 ÷ 12 = 72 cm³.

Edge of each cube (a) = √³72 = √³(8 × 9) = 2√³9 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 2√³9 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Dimensions of **cuboidal block** = 24 cm × 6 cm × 6 cm

Number of **recast** cubes = 12

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cuboid = Length × Breadth × Height

Volume of cube = (Edge)³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d66ef04b875942f37f2e4706242010f4f93a247ae1ba594cb136f7b24376dc80.png] 

⇒ Volume of the **cuboidal block** = 24 × 6 × 6 = 864 cm³

⇒ Let the **edge** of each identical cube be 'a' cm.

⇒ Total volume of 12 cubes = 12 × a³

⇒ Since the block is **melted** and **recast**, total volume remains constant.

⇒ 12 × a³ = 864

⇒ a³ = 864 ÷ 12

⇒ a³ = 72

⇒ a = √³72 = √³(8 × 9)

⇒ a = 2√³9 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 2√³9 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume Conservation

When a solid is **melted** and **recast** into another shape, the total volume remains the same.

Cube Properties

A cube has 12 edges, 8 vertices, and 6 faces. Volume = a³ and Total Surface Area = 6a².

Cuboid Properties

A cuboid has volume = l × b × h and diagonal = √(l² + b² + h²).</p

questions.question: Two tangents are drawn from an external point P to a circle, touching at points A and B. If the distance from P to the center O is 13 cm, and radius is 5 cm, what is the length of tangent PA?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The **tangent PA** is **perpendicular** to the **radius OA** at the point of contact **A**.

This forms a **right-angled triangle OAP** where **OP** is the **hypotenuse**.

Apply the standard **Pythagorean triplet**: (5, 12, 13).

Since **radius (OA) = 5 cm** and **hypotenuse (OP) = 13 cm**, the **tangent (PA)** must be **12 cm**.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Radius** of the circle (OA) = 5 cm

Distance of **external point P** from the **center O** (OP) = 13 cm

**Formula Used:**

In a **right-angled triangle**, by **Pythagoras Theorem**: **Hypotenuse² = Base² + Perpendicular²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/217087a7add3779c10305b785935350e2de9487b6d653045b9b40d39092866e9.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ In ΔOAP, ∠OAP = 90° (Radius ⊥ Tangent)

⇒ OP² = OA² + PA²

⇒ 13² = 5² + PA²

⇒ 169 = 25 + PA²

⇒ PA² = 169 − 25

⇒ PA² = 144

⇒ PA = √144

⇒ PA = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Tangent-Radius Property

The **tangent** at any point of a circle is **perpendicular** to the **radius** through the point of contact.

Tangents from an External Point

The lengths of the two **tangents** drawn from an **external point** to a circle are always **equal** (PA = PB).

Pythagorean Triplets

Common triplets like (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), and (8, 15, 17) help solve **right-triangle** geometry problems quickly.</p

questions.question: If triangle ABC is congruent to triangle FED, which of the following is true?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

In congruence notation Triangle ABC ≅ Triangle FED, the order of letters determines the **corresponding parts**.

Match positions: 1st (A → F), 2nd (B → E), 3rd (C → D).

Side CA consists of the 3rd and 1st vertices, so it must equal the side formed by the 3rd and 1st vertices of the other triangle (DF or FD).

**∴ The correct answer is CA = FD.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Triangle ABC ≅ Triangle FED

**Formula Used:** **CPCT** (Corresponding Parts of Congruent Triangles)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a2dfebbdadfdd0640079a0ff52cf436a1b888433101e8ba091cbb5913656044.png] 

According to the **CPCT** rule, if two triangles are congruent, their corresponding sides and angles are equal:

⇒ Vertex A corresponds to Vertex F

⇒ Vertex B corresponds to Vertex E

⇒ Vertex C corresponds to Vertex D

Now, let us check the equality of sides:

⇒ AB = FE

⇒ BC = ED

⇒ AC = FD (which can also be written as CA = FD)

Checking the equality of angles:

⇒ ∠A = ∠F

⇒ ∠B = ∠E

⇒ ∠C = ∠D

Comparing these results with the given options, only **CA = FD** is true.

**∴ The correct answer is CA = FD.**

**__Additional Information__**

CPCT Rule

**CPCT** stands for Corresponding Parts of Congruent Triangles. It states that if two triangles are proved congruent, then all their corresponding parts (sides and angles) are equal.

Criteria for Congruence

Triangles can be proven congruent using five main criteria: **SSS** (Side-Side-Side), **SAS** (Side-Angle-Side), **ASA** (Angle-Side-Angle), **AAS** (Angle-Angle-Side), and **RHS** (Right angle-Hypotenuse-Side).

Symbolic Notation

The order of vertices in the congruence statement (e.g., ΔABC ≅ ΔFED) is **mandatory** and must reflect the exact correspondence between the vertices.</p

questions.question: A chord PQ of a circle is equal to its radius. The angle subtended by this chord at a point on the major arc is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Chord PQ** = **Radius** ⇒ **Equilateral Triangle** is formed at the center.

**Central Angle** ∠POQ = 60°.

**Angle at Major Arc** = 1/2 × **Central Angle**.

Angle = 60° ÷ 2 = 30°.

**∴ The correct answer is 30°.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Chord PQ = Radius of the circle.

**Formula:** The angle subtended by an arc at the center is double the angle subtended by it at any point on the remaining part of the circle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2cc149080aee5ba4638646e2bd6cbec3a8935f251ce1d26cae6f68464e8d7f8.png] 

⇒ Let the radius of the circle be r.

⇒ In ΔOPQ, OP = OQ = r (Radii of the same circle).

⇒ Given, Chord PQ = r.

⇒ Since OP = OQ = PQ = r, ΔOPQ is an **Equilateral Triangle**.

⇒ ∠POQ = 60° (Each angle of an equilateral triangle is 60°).

⇒ Let R be a point on the **Major Arc**.

⇒ ∠PRQ = 1/2 × ∠POQ.

⇒ ∠PRQ = 1/2 × 60° = 30°.

**∴ The correct answer is 30°.**

**__Additional Information__**

Angle in a Semicircle

The angle subtended by a diameter at any point on the circumference is always 90°.

Cyclic Quadrilateral

The sum of opposite angles in a cyclic quadrilateral is 180°. If the angle at the major arc is θ, the angle at the minor arc is 180° − θ.

Angles in the Same Segment

Angles subtended by the same chord at any point on the same segment of the circle are equal.</p

questions.question: A positive number exceeds its square root by 132. Find the number given that it is also a multiple of 12.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Identify the multiple of 12 from the given options: 121, 196, 144, 169.

Only 144 is divisible by 12 (144 ÷ 12 = 12).

Verify the condition: Number − √Number = 132.

144 − √144 = 144 − 12 = 132.

The condition is perfectly satisfied.

**∴ The correct answer is 144.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x − √x = 132

x is a multiple of 12.

**Formula Used:**

Quadratic factorization: y² − y − 132 = 0

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09f3f2be95f5923feea2bc4a674cf4ba889e0e6d302303880c317be16f0deaa2.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let √x = y, then x = y².

⇒ y² − y = 132

⇒ y² − y − 132 = 0

⇒ y² − 12y + 11y − 132 = 0

⇒ y(y − 12) + 11(y − 12) = 0

⇒ (y − 12)(y + 11) = 0

⇒ y = 12 (Since x is a positive number, y cannot be −11)

⇒ x = y² = 12² = 144

⇒ Check multiple: 144 ÷ 12 = 12 (Satisfied)

**∴ The correct answer is 144.**

**__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 12

A number is divisible by 12 if it is divisible by both 3 and 4. For 144, 1+4+4=9 (divisible by 3) and 44 is divisible by 4.

Quadratic Roots Property

For y² − y − 132 = 0, the product of roots is −132 and the sum of roots is 1. The roots 12 and −11 satisfy this.

Perfect Squares

If a number exceeds its square root by an integer, the number must be a perfect square (e.g., 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ...).</p

questions.question: Given below are two statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read and mark the correct options:**Assertion (A):** The product of any two consecutive natural numbers is always even.**Reason (R):** If n is any natural number, then either n or n+1 must be divisible by 2, ensuring the product is even.

options.text: Both A and R are accurate, and R clearly justifies A
A is valid, R is valid, but R is not directly explaining A
Neither A nor R hold true

questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Consecutive natural numbers always follow the parity pattern (Odd, Even) or (Even, Odd).

The product of an Odd number and an Even number is always an **Even number**.

Reason (R) correctly identifies that either n or n+1 must be divisible by 2.

This ensures the product is always even, making Assertion (A) correct and justified.

**∴ The correct answer is Both A and R are accurate, and R clearly justifies A.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3527e749407ef9fed8639c33e42a70bd9b418f4a18e387034fddb3c55c67d7e8.png] 

Given: Two consecutive natural numbers n and n+1.

⇒ Let n be any natural number. The next consecutive number is n + 1.

⇒ If n is **Even**, then n is divisible by 2. Thus, n × (n+1) is divisible by 2.

⇒ If n is **Odd**, then n + 1 is **Even** and divisible by 2. Thus, n × (n+1) is divisible by 2.

⇒ In both possible cases, the product contains a factor of 2, ensuring it is always even.

⇒ Reason (R) provides the exact logical explanation for Assertion (A).

**∴ The correct answer is Both A and R are accurate, and R clearly justifies A.**

**__Additional Information__**

Product of r Consecutive Integers

The product of any r consecutive integers is always divisible by r!. For example, the product of three consecutive numbers is always divisible by 3! = 6.

Sum of Consecutive Numbers

The sum of any two consecutive natural numbers is always **Odd**, as it follows the form n + (n + 1) = 2n + 1.

Parity Multiplication Rules

Even × Even = Even | Even × Odd = Even | Odd × Odd = Odd. Since consecutive numbers always include one even number, their product is always even.</p

questions.question: Which set of numbers includes all others?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The hierarchy of number sets is: **Whole numbers** ⊂ **Integers** ⊂ **Rational numbers** ⊂ **Real numbers**.

**Real numbers** consist of the union of all **Rational** and **Irrational numbers**.

Every **Whole number** is an **Integer**, and every **Integer** is a **Rational number**.

Every **Rational number** is a **Real number**, making it the ultimate superset among the options.

**∴ The correct answer is Real number.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given sets: **Integers**, **Rational numbers**, **Whole numbers**, **Real numbers**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b6c1dd23722917573ef07585f20a8f5b02df609eb1247ed5282029f914e9317.png] 

⇒ **Whole numbers** (W) = {0, 1, 2, 3, ...}

⇒ **Integers** (Z) = {..., −2, −1, 0, 1, 2, ...} ∴ W is a subset of Z.

⇒ **Rational numbers** (Q) = {p/q : p, q are integers, q ≠ 0} ∴ Z is a subset of Q.

⇒ **Real numbers** (R) = Rational ∪ Irrational Numbers ∴ Q is a subset of R.

⇒ By transitivity, R includes Q, Z, and W.

**∴ The correct answer is Real number.**

**__Additional Information__**

Natural Numbers

Counting numbers starting from 1 {1, 2, 3, ...}. They are a subset of **Whole numbers**.

Irrational Numbers

Numbers that cannot be expressed as p/q, such as √2, √3, and π. Together with **Rational numbers**, they form the set of **Real numbers**.

Complex Numbers

The set of numbers in the form a + bi, where a and b are **Real numbers**. This is the largest set and includes **Real numbers** as a subset.</p

questions.question: In a workshop, the ratio of skilled to unskilled workers was **5 : 4**. After a hiring drive, the number of skilled workers increased by **10%**, while the number of unskilled workers increased by **25%**. What is the new ratio of skilled to unskilled workers?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Initial Ratio of **Skilled** to **Unskilled** workers = 5 : 4

New **Skilled** workers = 5 × 110% = 5.5 units

New **Unskilled** workers = 4 × 125% = 5.0 units

New Ratio = 5.5 : 5.0 = 55 : 50 = 11 : 10

**∴ The correct answer is 11 : 10.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/759ec674a045ceee1872d767135cb978fcff21dcff4336213762ffd36bacdc53.png] 

Given: Initial ratio of **Skilled** to **Unskilled** workers = 5 : 4.

Formula Used: **New Value** = **Original Value** × (100 + **% Increase**) ÷ 100

⇒ Let the number of **skilled workers** be 500 and **unskilled workers** be 400.

⇒ New number of **skilled workers** = 500 + (10% of 500) = 500 + 50 = 550.

⇒ New number of **unskilled workers** = 400 + (25% of 400) = 400 + 100 = 500.

⇒ **New Ratio** = 550 : 500.

⇒ Dividing both terms by 50: **New Ratio** = 11 : 10.

**∴ The correct answer is 11 : 10.**

**__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change in Ratio

When terms of a ratio a : b increase by x% and y% respectively, the new ratio becomes a(1 + x/100) : b(1 + y/100).

Ratio Multiplier Property

Multiplying both terms of a ratio by the same non-zero constant (k) does not change the ratio (a : b = ka : kb).

Base Value Assumption

Assuming base values like 100 or 1000 for ratio parts simplifies percentage calculations significantly.</p

questions.question: A student scores 25% more marks in Science than in Math. If he scores 240 marks in Science, how many marks did he score in Math?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**25% more** is equivalent to the fraction **1/4** increase.

Ratio of **Math** marks to **Science** marks = 4 : (4 + 1) = **4 : 5**.

Given **Science** marks (5 units) = **240**.

1 unit = 240 ÷ 5 = **48**.

**Math** marks (4 units) = 4 × 48 = **192**.

**∴ The correct answer is 192.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Marks in **Science** = 240. **Science** marks are **25% more** than **Math** marks.

**Formula Used:** New Value = Base Value × (100 + % Increase) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3adafdf09698fbcccb554ff8da004eebd12b30a325a3f09d0dc4d5e55e62ccd4.png] 

⇒ Let the marks in **Math** be **x**.

⇒ Marks in **Science** = x + 25% of x

⇒ 240 = x + (25 ÷ 100) × x

⇒ 240 = x + 0.25x

⇒ 240 = 1.25x

⇒ x = 240 ÷ 1.25

⇒ x = (240 × 100) ÷ 125

⇒ x = 240 × (4 ÷ 5)

⇒ x = 48 × 4

⇒ x = **192**.

**∴ The correct answer is 192.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Increase

To find the original value after an increase: **Original = Final Value ÷ (1 + r/100)**, where r is the percentage rate.

Fractional Conversion

Common percentages to fractions: **20% = 1/5**, **25% = 1/4**, **33.33% = 1/3**, **50% = 1/2**.

Base Change Rule

If A is 25% more than B, then B is **[25 ÷ (100 + 25)] × 100 = 20%** less than A.</p

questions.question: Let x and y be angles such that sin(x + y) = 0 and cos(x - y) = 1 . What is the value of the expression: (cos x + cos y)² + (sin x - sin y)² ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity:

(cos x + cos y)² + (sin x − sin y)² = 2 + 2cos(x + y)

Given sin(x + y) = 0 and cos(x − y) = 1

⇒ x + y = nπ and x − y = 2nπ

⇒ cos(x + y) = 1

⇒ Required value = 2 + 2(1) = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4 units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

sin(x + y) = 0

cos(x − y) = 1

Expression:

(cos x + cos y)² + (sin x − sin y)²

Formula Used:

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

⇒ (cos x + cos y)²

⇒ = cos²x + cos²y + 2cos x cos y

⇒ (sin x − sin y)²

⇒ = sin²x + sin²y − 2sin x sin y

⇒ Adding both:

⇒ cos²x + sin²x + cos²y + sin²y + 2(cos x cos y − sin x sin y)

⇒ = 1 + 1 + 2cos(x + y)

⇒ = 2 + 2cos(x + y)

⇒ Since sin(x + y) = 0 and cos(x − y) = 1

⇒ x + y = 0, π, 2π ...

⇒ Taking principal value, cos(x + y) = 1

⇒ Required value = 2 + 2(1)

⇒ = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4 units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identity

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 is the most frequently used trigonometric identity.

Cosine Addition Formula

cos(A + B) = cos A cos B − sin A sin B.

General Solution of sin θ = 0

If sin θ = 0, then θ = nπ where n is an integer.

General Solution of cos θ = 1

If cos θ = 1, then θ = 2nπ where n is an integer.

questions.question: A company undertakes a project to be completed in 40 days with 80 workers. After 10 days, due to a shortage, only 60 workers remain. How many additional workers must be hired after 20 more days to complete the project on time?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total work = 80 workers × 40 days = 3200 man-days.

Work done in 30 days = (80 × 10) + (60 × 20) = 800 + 1200 = 2000 man-days.

Remaining work = 3200 − 2000 = 1200 man-days.

Remaining time = 40 − 30 = 10 days.

Workers required = 1200 ÷ 10 = 120 workers.

Additional workers = 120 − 60 = 60.

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Initial workers = 80, Total days = 40, Workers after 10 days = 60.

**Formula:** Total Work = Workers × Days

questions.question: The time taken for a train to pass a pole is 18 seconds, while it takes 33 seconds to cross a bridge measuring 300 meters. Calculate the length of the train.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Extra time taken to cross the bridge = 33 − 18 = 15 seconds.

This extra 15 seconds is the time required to cover the bridge length of 300 meters.

Speed of the train = 300 ÷ 15 = 20 m/s.

Length of the train = Speed × Time to cross pole = 20 × 18 = 360 meters.

**∴ The correct answer is 360 meters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time to cross pole = 18 s

Time to cross bridge = 33 s

Length of bridge = 300 m

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/946ac04cc4284ab344970684b508b71c21860eee4085b3cd0cc30312bd763418.png] 

Let the length of the train be L meters.

⇒ Speed of train = Distance ÷ Time

⇒ Speed = L ÷ 18 (while crossing the pole)

⇒ Speed = (L + 300) ÷ 33 (while crossing the bridge)

Equating the speed in both cases:

⇒ L ÷ 18 = (L + 300) ÷ 33

⇒ 33 × L = 18 × (L + 300)

⇒ 33L = 18L + 5400

⇒ 33L − 18L = 5400

⇒ 15L = 5400

⇒ L = 5400 ÷ 15

⇒ L = 360 meters

**∴ The correct answer is 360 meters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Crossing Stationary Objects

When a train crosses a point object (pole, man, tree), distance = length of train. When it crosses a platform, bridge, or another stationary train, distance = length of train + length of the object.

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert from m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Relative Speed

If two objects move in the same direction, relative speed = S₁ − S₂. If they move in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.</p

questions.question: Two equal sums are lent at 6% and 9% simple interest per annum respectively. The interest received on both sums after 4 years differs by ₹150. Find each sum.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in **annual interest rates** = 9% − 6% = 3%

Total difference in **percentage** for 4 years = 3% × 4 = 12%

Given that 12% of the **sum** corresponds to ₹150

Sum (100%) = (150 ÷ 12) × 100

Sum = 12.5 × 100 = ₹1250

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1250.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Rates R₁ = 6%, R₂ = 9%, Time T = 4 years, Difference in Interest = ₹150

**Formula Used:** Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/229b5d985b1d3fa5d3871bd19c88e2cdde1c24c16912d03c05ad43bc70836cbe.png] 

⇒ Let the **equal sum** lent in each case be P.

⇒ Interest from first sum (SI₁) = (P × 6 × 4) ÷ 100 = 24P/100

⇒ Interest from second sum (SI₂) = (P × 9 × 4) ÷ 100 = 36P/100

⇒ According to the problem: SI₂ − SI₁ = 150

⇒ (36P/100) − (24P/100) = 150

⇒ 12P/100 = 150

⇒ 12P = 150 × 100

⇒ P = 15000 ÷ 12

⇒ P = 1250

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1250.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

**Simple Interest** is calculated only on the **Principal** amount, whereas **Compound Interest** is calculated on the Principal plus the accumulated interest of previous periods.

Total Amount Formula

The **Amount (A)** is the sum of Principal and Interest: A = P + SI = P(1 + RT/100).

Effect of Rate Change

If the **Rate** increases by R%, the interest for T years increases by (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

questions.question: If tanθ + cotθ = k, then tan²θ + cot²θ is equal to:

questions.question: The angle of elevation of the top of a tower from a point 60 m away from its base is 45°. Find the height of the tower.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

When the **angle of elevation** is 45°, the **height** of the tower is always equal to its **distance** from the observation point.

This is because tan 45° = 1, which means the **Perpendicular** and **Base** are equal in an **isosceles right triangle**.

Height = Distance = 60 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 60 m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance from the base of the **tower** (BC) = 60 m

**Angle of elevation** (θ) = 45°

**Formula Used:**

tan θ = Perpendicular / Base

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4f325e87b00337a6f8fd03197e9c7007d5b1a0aed7a6ddba8dd2aeb1cbe0321.png] 

⇒ Let the **height** of the tower be AB = h.

⇒ In the right-angled triangle ABC, tan 45° = AB / BC

⇒ 1 = h / 60

⇒ h = 60 m

**∴ The correct answer is 60 m.**

**__Additional Information__**

Angle of Elevation

The angle formed by the **line of sight** with the horizontal when the object being viewed is **above** the horizontal level.

Standard Trigonometric Ratios

For a 30° angle, tan 30° = 1 / √3. For a 60° angle, tan 60° = √3.

Isosceles Right Triangle Property

In a triangle with angles 45°, 45°, and 90°, the sides are always in the ratio **1 : 1 : √2**.</p

questions.question: The value of sqrt{(5 + 2sqrt{6})} is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the **square root** of a surd in the form √(x + 2√y), find two numbers whose **sum** is x and **product** is y.

Here, x = 5 and y = 6.

The two numbers are **3** and **2** (since 3 + 2 = 5 and 3 × 2 = 6).

The result is simply √3 + √2.

**∴ The correct answer is √3 + √2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Expression = √(5 + 2√6)

**Formula Used:** (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

⇒ 5 + 2√6 = 3 + 2 + 2√(3 × 2)

⇒ 5 + 2√6 = (√3)² + (√2)² + 2(√3)(√2)

⇒ 5 + 2√6 = (√3 + √2)²

⇒ √(5 + 2√6) = √[(√3 + √2)²]

⇒ √(5 + 2√6) = √3 + √2

**∴ The correct answer is √3 + √2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square Root of a Surd

For an expression √(a + 2√b), the value is √x + √y where x + y = a and xy = b. If the sign is negative, √(a − 2√b) = √x − √y (where x > y).

Rationalization

To rationalize a denominator like 1/(√a + √b), multiply both numerator and denominator by the **conjugate** (√a − √b).

Algebraic Identities

The identities (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab and (a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab are fundamental for simplifying **nested radicals**.

questions.question: Find the coordinates of the point where the line 2x + 3y = 6 intersects the y-axis.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

To find the **y-axis intersection**, simply set the **x-coordinate** to 0.

In the equation 2x + 3y = 6, putting x = 0 gives:

3y = 6 → y = 2

The required point is (0, 2).

**∴ The correct answer is (0, 2).**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Equation of the line is 2x + 3y = 6.

**Formula Used:** At the point of **intersection** with the **y-axis**, the **x-coordinate** is always 0.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f81031c89e861044ebda19851d6fc640ff392e14e4a9ebf077d62e5628c88bf1.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Substitute x = 0 in the equation 2x + 3y = 6

⇒ 2 × 0 + 3y = 6

⇒ 0 + 3y = 6

⇒ 3y = 6

⇒ y = 6 ÷ 3

⇒ y = 2

∴ The coordinates of the point are (0, 2).

**∴ The correct answer is (0, 2).**

**__Additional Information__**

X-intercept

The point where the line crosses the **x-axis** is found by setting y = 0. For 2x + 3y = 6, the x-intercept is (3, 0).

Intercept Form

A line equation can be written as x/a + y/b = 1, where 'a' is the **x-intercept** and 'b' is the **y-intercept**.

Slope-Intercept Form

The form y = mx + c gives the **slope** (m) and the **y-intercept** (c) directly. For 2x + 3y = 6, y = (−2/3)x + 2.</p

questions.question: If x - 1/x = 3, then the value of x² + 1/x² is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x − 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² + 2

Given: k = 3

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 3² + 2 = 9 + 2 = 11

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: x − 1/x = 3

Formula Used: (a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

⇒ Square both sides of the given equation:

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 3²

⇒ x² + (1/x)² − 2 × x × (1/x) = 9

⇒ x² + 1/x² − 2 = 9

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 9 + 2

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 11

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Square Identity (Sum)

If x + 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² − 2.

Algebraic Cubic Identity (Difference)

If x − 1/x = k, then x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k.

Relation between Squares of Sum and Difference

(x + 1/x)² − (x − 1/x)² = 4. This is used to find x + 1/x when x − 1/x is known.</p

questions.question: The expression (x + y + z)² - (x² + y² + z²) is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Substitute **x = 1, y = 1, and z = 1** into the expression to verify the identity.

Expression value = (1 + 1 + 1)² − (1² + 1² + 1²) = 3² − 3 = **6**.

Check Option 1: 2(1×1 + 1×1 + 1×1) = 2(1 + 1 + 1) = 2(3) = **6**.

Since the values match, the expression is equivalent to 2(xy + yz + zx).

**∴ The correct answer is 2(xy + yz + zx).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (x + y + z)² − (x² + y² + z²)

**Formula Used:** (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca

⇒ Expand the first part: (x + y + z)² = x² + y² + z² + 2xy + 2yz + 2zx

⇒ Substitute this expansion back into the original expression:

⇒ (x² + y² + z² + 2xy + 2yz + 2zx) − (x² + y² + z²)

⇒ 2xy + 2yz + 2zx

⇒ 2(xy + yz + zx)

**∴ The correct answer is 2(xy + yz + zx).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square of a Trinomial

The identity (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca) is a standard **algebraic expansion** used to solve multi-variable problems.

Sum of Cubes Identity

a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca).

Special Case for Cubes

If **a + b + c = 0**, then the relation simplifies to **a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc**, which is frequently tested in competitive exams.

questions.question: The average of 6 numbers is 45. The average of the first four numbers is 40, and the fifth number is 50. What is the sixth number?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net deviation from the overall average (45) must be zero.

Deviation of first 4 numbers = 4 × (40 − 45) = −20

Deviation of 5th number = (50 − 45) = +5

Total deviation so far = −20 + 5 = −15

To balance, the 6th number must have a deviation of +15.

6th number = 45 + 15 = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 6 numbers = 45

Average of first 4 numbers = 40

Value of 5th number = 50

**Formula Used:**

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0c29d55dca1b1170d30e1067f6f36038d397562359b59a717fabde834333663.png] 

⇒ Sum of all 6 numbers = 6 × 45 = 270

⇒ Sum of first 4 numbers = 4 × 40 = 160

⇒ Sum of first 5 numbers = 160 + 50 = 210

⇒ 6th number = Total Sum − Sum of first 5 numbers

⇒ 6th number = 270 − 210 = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

When two groups with averages A₁ and A₂ and sizes n₁ and n₂ are combined, the new average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Deviation Principle

The algebraic sum of deviations of a set of observations from their arithmetic mean is always zero.

Effect of Change

If each number in a set is increased by 'k', the average also increases by 'k'. If each is multiplied by 'k', the average is multiplied by 'k'.</p

questions.question: Two vertical poles have heights of 6 meters and 11 meters vertically on a plane ground. If the distance between their feet is 12 m, the distance between their tops is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Identify the **height difference** between the two poles: 11 − 6 = 5 m.

The **horizontal distance** between the feet is given as 12 m.

These two values form the legs of a **right-angled triangle** where the distance between the tops is the **hypotenuse**.

Apply the standard **Pythagorean triplet** (5, 12, 13) directly.

The **hypotenuse** (distance between tops) must be 13 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 13 m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of first pole (h₁) = 6 m

Height of second pole (h₂) = 11 m

Distance between feet (d) = 12 m

**Formula Used:**

In a **right-angled triangle**, according to **Pythagoras Theorem**: Hypotenuse² = Base² + Perpendicular²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22de904b10248c2789a3a18c901494b1c5b64d0c57d9a31f1d799ef2ecf0ce0d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the distance between the tops be **x**.

⇒ The vertical difference between the tops = h₂ − h₁ = 11 − 6 = 5 m.

⇒ The horizontal distance remains the same = 12 m.

⇒ x² = 5² + 12²

⇒ x² = 25 + 144

⇒ x² = 169

⇒ x = √169

⇒ x = 13 m

**∴ The correct answer is 13 m.**

**__Additional Information__**

Pythagoras Theorem

In any **right-angled triangle**, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides (a² + b² = c²).

Common Pythagorean Triplets

Memorizing triplets like (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (8, 15, 17), and (7, 24, 25) helps solve **geometry** and **distance** problems much faster.

Vertical Alignment

When objects are placed **vertically** on a plane ground, they are assumed to be at a 90° angle to the horizontal surface, allowing the use of **trigonometry** and **right-triangle properties**.</p

questions.question: 36 men can complete a work in 36 days. They started working together. But 6 men kept on leaving the job every 7th day. In how many days will the work be completed?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = 36 men × 36 days = 1296 units.

Work done in 35 days (5 intervals of 7) = 7 × (36 + 30 + 24 + 18 + 12) = 840 units.

Remaining work = 1296 − 840 = 456 units.

Days taken by last 6 men = 456 ÷ 6 = 76 days.

Total days = 35 + 76 = 111 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 111 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Men (M) = 36

Initial Days (D) = 36

Rate of leaving = 6 men every 7th day

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Men × Days

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ef471cbee2852385befa17e766c33f794d09c648f5e1b77ddd62671ecd613cf.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total work required = 36 × 36 = 1296 man-days.

⇒ Work done in 1st week (1-7 days) = 36 × 7 = 252 units.

⇒ Work done in 2nd week (8-14 days) = 30 × 7 = 210 units.

⇒ Work done in 3rd week (15-21 days) = 24 × 7 = 168 units.

⇒ Work done in 4th week (22-28 days) = 18 × 7 = 126 units.

⇒ Work done in 5th week (29-35 days) = 12 × 7 = 84 units.

⇒ Sum of work done until 35 days = 252 + 210 + 168 + 126 + 84 = 840 units.

⇒ Remaining work = 1296 − 840 = 456 units.

⇒ Men remaining after 35th day = 12 − 6 = 6 men.

⇒ Time taken by 6 men to complete 456 units = 456 ÷ 6 = 76 days.

⇒ Total days = 35 + 76 = 111 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 111 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Work Concept

Work is constant and is calculated as the product of the number of workers and the time taken (W = M × D).

Variable Efficiency

When workers leave or join, the daily work rate changes. Total work is the sum of work done in each specific interval: Σ(Mᵢ × Dᵢ).

Chain Rule

The relationship between men, days, and work is given by (M₁×D₁×H₁)/W₁ = (M₂×D₂×H₂)/W₂.</p

questions.question: A car travels from A to B at 80 km/h and returns at 60 km/h. Find the approx. average speed of the car.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the distance covered is the same for both speeds, Average Speed = (2 × x × y) / (x + y)

Here, x = 80 km/h and y = 60 km/h.

Average Speed = (2 × 80 × 60) / (80 + 60) = 9600 / 140 = 960 / 14

Average Speed = 480 / 7 ≈ 68.57 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 68.57 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed from A to B (S₁) = 80 km/h

Speed from B to A (S₂) = 60 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95f28bbda53e3fd5fcf1ef79db8e1c6b496d1a9ef6c286d9b1f93f487acf2ac3.png] 

Let the distance between A and B be the LCM of 80 and 60 = 240 km.

⇒ Time taken from A to B (t₁) = 240 ÷ 80 = 3 hours

⇒ Time taken from B to A (t₂) = 240 ÷ 60 = 4 hours

⇒ Total Distance = 240 + 240 = 480 km

⇒ Total Time = 3 + 4 = 7 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 480 ÷ 7

⇒ Average Speed ≈ 68.57 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 68.57 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed (Equal Time)

If a person travels for equal time intervals at speeds v₁ and v₂, then Average Speed = (v₁ + v₂) ÷ 2.

Harmonic Mean Property

The average speed for equal distances is the Harmonic Mean of the individual speeds: 2 ÷ [(1/v₁) + (1/v₂)].

Conversion of Units

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

questions.question: Six cubes, each with an edge 4.5 cm are joined end to end. Find the total surface area of the resulting cuboid.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total faces of 6 independent cubes = 6 × 6 = 36.

When joined end-to-end, 5 joints are formed, and each joint hides 2 faces.

Total faces hidden = 5 × 2 = 10.

Total remaining faces = 36 − 10 = 26.

Total Surface Area = 26 × (4.5)² = 26 × 20.25 = 526.5 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 526.5 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Edge of each cube (a) = 4.5 cm

When 6 cubes are joined end to end, the dimensions of the resulting cuboid are:

Length (l) = 6 × 4.5 = 27 cm

Breadth (b) = 4.5 cm

Height (h) = 4.5 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68e4fd16582525daba645a8c108427bd81ccde777548262953651fbdb2374a6d.png] 

Formula: Total Surface Area of cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

⇒ TSA = 2 × (27 × 4.5 + 4.5 × 4.5 + 4.5 × 27)

⇒ TSA = 2 × (121.5 + 20.25 + 121.5)

⇒ TSA = 2 × (263.25)

⇒ TSA = 526.5 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 526.5 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cuboid

The volume (V) of the resulting cuboid is given by l × b × h. Here, V = 27 × 4.5 × 4.5 = 546.75 cm³.

Lateral Surface Area

Lateral Surface Area (LSA) excludes the top and bottom faces. Formula: LSA = 2h(l + b) = 2 × 4.5 × (27 + 4.5) = 283.5 cm².

Diagonal of Cuboid

The longest rod that can be placed in a cuboid is its diagonal = √(l² + b² + h²).</p
